question: bilhan-2 is recorded with more than one father: ashbel, jediael.

actions.why: The Hebrew names Bilhan as a son of Jediael, not Ashbel. None of the supplied verses identifies Jediael with Ashbel.

note: Bilhan's stated parent is Jediael; the distinguisher's claim that Jediael is also called Ashbel is unsupported. The supplied verses do not establish whether this Jediael is the son of Shimri in 1CH 11:45, so that record's identity remains unresolved.
